name: Allow-AzureActiveDirectory-443
description: Entra ID token acquisition (login.microsoftonline.com) for kubelet, add-ons and workload identity.

name: Allow-MicrosoftContainerRegistry-443
description: Microsoft Artifact Registry (mcr.microsoft.com) for AKS system images.

name: Allow-AzureMonitor-443
description: Container Insights / Azure Monitor agent data ingestion.

name: Allow-AzureCloud-443
description: Catch-all for AKS FQDN dependencies hosted in Azure without a dedicated service tag (management.azure.com, packages.aks.azure.com, Defender, Policy). Narrow or remove once you front egress with Azure Firewall.

name: Deny-Internet-Outbound
description: Block all other Internet egress from the AKS subnets. Traffic to the virtual network (private endpoints, peered vNets) is still allowed by the default AllowVnetOutBound rule.
